GENERAL HEADQUARTERS
SUPREME COMMANDER FOR THE ALLIED POWERS
AG 072 (23 Jul 47) CPC/PP
(SCAPIN-1752)
APO 500
23 July 1947
MEMORANDUM FOR : JAPANESE GOVERNMENT.
THROUGH : Central Liaison Office, Tokyo.
SUBJECT : Formation of Liaison Agency in the Bureau of Patents and Standards.
1. Reference is made to the following memoranda for the Japanese Government from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers:
a. File AG 072 (17 Dec 46)CPC/FP, SCAPIN 2811-A, 17 December 1946, subject, “Use of United Nations Patents, Utility Models, Designs, Trademarks and Copyrights.”
b. File AG 072 (30 Nov 46) CPC/FP, SCAPIN 1371, 30 November 1946, subject. "Bank Deposits From Royalty Payments on Patents and Copyrights of United Nations Nationals."
c. File AG 072 (13 Jul 46) CPC/FP, SCAPIN 1725-A, 13 July 1946, subject, “Japanese Patents, Utility Models, Designs and Trademarks.”
d. File AG 072 (8 Mar 46) ESS/LE, SCAPIN 802, 8 March 1946, subject, “Patent Rights and Restrictions Concerning Patent Rights.”
2. The Japanese Government is directed to establish in the Bureau of Patents and Standards, Ministry of Commerce and Industry, a Patent Property Administrative Section, hereinafter referred to as the Section, to act as liaison for all matters concerning patent property between the Bureau of Patents and Standards and the Patent Property Division of the Office of the Civil Property Custodian, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
3. The Section shall be organized substantially as shown on the attached “Functional Chart of Patent Property Administrative Section,” and its functions shall include, but not be limited to, those indicated on the said chart.
4. In addition, the Section shall be responsible for transmitting to the Office of the Civil Property Custodian, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, any information its members may receive with regard to evasion of directives concerning patent property from General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers.
5. Organization of the Section shall be completed as rapidly as qualified personnel can be obtained, and, in any case, within 60 days from the date of this directive, but the functions and duties of the Section shall be assumed and undertaken immediately, and shall be carried out to the limit of its abilities consistent with the personnel at hand.
6. Direct communication is authorized between the Office of the Civil Property Custodian, General Headquarters, Supreme Commander for the Allied Powers, and the “Patent Property Administrative Section” of the Ministry of Commerce and Industry, Japanese Government, regarding routine matters of administration of patent properties.
FOR THE SUPREME COMMANDER:
R.M. LEVY,
Colonel, AGD,
Adjutant General.
Incl Functional Chart (For addressee only)
